entries.text: "This certificate's build-step history is complete."
"No build step was omitted from this certificate."
"Every failed attempt, waived step, or replan is represented in this certificate."
"This certificate's step universe was reconciled against a plan; nothing outside the plan happened."
"This certificate's event ledger is provably free of deletion, reordering, or truncation by any party, including Traigent staff."
"A signed chain root proves the underlying event sequence is complete and unaltered."
"This certificate is tamper-resistant against the party that issues it."
"The agent revision certified here is the agent revision currently deployed."
"No drift has occurred between certification and now."
"This certificate remains authoritative for the agent wherever it is running."
"The evaluation dataset used correctly measures the target task."
"The evaluator (judge/scorer) used is a correct or unbiased measure of the metric it reports."
"The certified agent behaves correctly, or as intended, in general."
"The certified result generalizes to inputs, workloads, or deployments beyond the declared evaluation."
"Because the certified configuration won on the declared dataset, it is the best configuration for the customer's production traffic."
"Passing this certificate's evaluation implies the agent will pass a materially different or expanded evaluation."
"The certified configuration is statistically better than the alternatives evaluated against it."
"The certified winner is reproducible / would win again if re-run."
"The margin between the winning configuration and the runner-up is meaningful or reliable."
"The certificate's statistical language remains valid across a criteria change."
"No data leaves the customer's environment under this certificate's disclosed scope."
"This certificate proves privacy-preserving operation."
"Free-form content never crosses the certified boundary, as a general product statement."
"A cryptographic commitment on this certificate proves the underlying content is private."
"This certificate can be independently verified without contacting Traigent."
"A relying party outside Traigent can reproduce this certificate's verification result today."
"This certificate remains verifiable after Traigent upgrades its schemas or software."
"The private key used to sign this certificate is held under audited custody with restricted mint authority."
"This certificate can be checked against a revocation list to confirm the signing key was not compromised."
"Only Traigent-authorized principals can mint a certificate with this issuer key."
"No LLM involved in producing this certificate or the report it certifies ever hallucinated."
"This certificate's free-text narrative sections are factually accurate."
"A high claim-acceptance rate under C1 means the underlying work was correct."
"Fields withheld from this disclosure profile are still provably present and accounted for."
"This certificate is interoperable with third-party selective-disclosure standards (e.g., C2PA)."
"A customer's choice to withhold a field from disclosure is itself concealed."
"This certificate remains valid indefinitely once issued."
"A certificate that has not been re-checked recently is still current."
"Re-issuing a certificate under upgraded verifiers is an update to the original certificate."
"The absence of a drift, revocation, or re-verification finding on this certificate means none occurred."
